slots.hypothesis: Unchanged, passed audit 1 at 3/3. The periphery around the volume-centroid core: a screen that excludes limit-lock / frozen events, cross-day co-movement of trade timing with intraday direction, a persistent-vs-temporary split, and a closing-auction footprint pool. Struck seed 5 and table-struck seeds 8 and 13 stay in place with their numbering.

Rewritten to the auditor's five points. The idea is the same: for the same day direction, does volume land where price has just risen locally (chasing, positive feedback; Barber-Odean 2008, De Long et al. 1990) or where it has just fallen (contrarian absorption; Kaniel-Saar-Titman 2008)? Long the absorption side. Implementation: (1) the local position is lagged one minute, in_delay(div(Close, in_mean_rolling(Close,30)),1), then correlated with sqrt(Volume). Before the 20-day mean, each day is cs_bucket_rank'ed within deciles of that day's open-to-close return and/or W = day_wmean(Ret, Volume), so it is orthogonal to direction by construction. One seed also buckets the 20-day mean on the rev control expression itself. (2) Seeds 2-6 bucket on head +0.58's own component W; predicted residual |rho| to that head < 0.4. (3) Only 20-day windows; the 40/60-day seeds and the unsplit controls are gone. (4) The Kyle branch is replaced by a sign(Ret) split: corr(pre-minute position, signed sqrt volume) minus the same corr without volume weights, which removes bid-ask bounce and minute-return autocorrelation. (5) The two level versions stay, bucketed daily on (centroid - 0.5) x intraday log return; the VWAP/TWAP denominator is now masked too. 11 new seeds. Predicted rev <= 0.25 (seed 7 <= 0.05), heads mostly < 0.3 (all < 0.45), liq/vol/known <= 0.4.
